text:
maya: Quick sync — I'm drafting a take-home lab for our SI certification cohort. Need input on: hardware checklist, pass/fail rubric, and whether we let partners run on their own infra or use a managed sandbox. Thoughts?

devin: +1. My vote: managed sandbox for the first run (reduces ops friction), optional self-hosted for advanced track.

sachin: Agree with sandbox. If we do self-hosted, we should have a small preflight script that validates CUDA/cuDNN, driver, and network egress rules. Example we can re-use: ```./si_preflight.sh --check-gpu --check-network```

maya: Good — can you paste a minimal preflight here, sachin? We'll put it into the lab repo.

sachin: Sure, rough snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
# quick checks
nvidia-smi >/dev/null || { echo "no GPU"; exit 1; }
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())" || { echo "torch missing"; exit 1; }
curl -fsS https://internal-redwood-test/ok || echo "network check failed"```

jamie: For scoring: propose 3 buckets — "passes infra", "completes basic inference (latency < X)" and "reports eval against sample prompts". Pass required: infra + basic inference. Bonus for evaluation coverage.

maya: Love that. We should make the latency target explicit and tier it by hardware class (A100, H100, etc.). devin — can you draft targets?

devin: I'll draft. Quick Q: certification duration — do we keep it 2 weeks take-home or extend to 3 for self-hosted?

maya: 2 weeks for sandbox, 3 weeks if self-hosted. Keep momentum.

partner-bot: New doc created: https://go.redwood.dev/si-takehome-lab-draft (permissions: partnerships, training).

jamie: Also: add a checklist for data handling / redaction for any partner logs they upload. We can't accept PII. Short item: "sanitize logs before upload" and provide a small Python sanitizer example.

sachin: I'll add a `sanitize_logs.py` snippet to the repo.

maya: Action items: devin -> latency targets by hw class (due EOD Tue), sachin -> preflight + sanitizer PR (due Thu), jamie -> final rubric doc and grading spreadsheet (due Fri). I'll set up a short review call on Wed 10am PT. @devin @sachin @jamie please react when you confirm. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

devin: ✅

sachin: ✅ will start PR today

jamie: ✅ adding rubric outline now

maya: Thanks team — we'll include a short partner-facing FAQ and a one-page "what to expect" that the SI can hand to their customer success lead.
